title: Buttery Algerian Date Quesadilla
description: A sweet and savory twist on the classic quesadilla, featuring the rich flavors of buttery pastry, algerian spices, and sweet dates.
instructions: Preheat a dry skillet over medium heat.
Place a buttery pastry sheet in the skillet and sprinkle with Algerian spice blend.
Fold the pastry sheet in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Flip and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
